BarConfig.description: The `[bar]` table: placement, geometry and motion of every bar.

focal.description: Module that gets the neon glow, or `"none"`.

margin.description: Gap between the bar and the output edges, in pixels.

monitors.description: Outputs that get a bar: `"all"` or a list of connector names such as `["DP-1"]`.

position.description: Edge of the output the bar sits on.

radius.description: Corner radius of the bar, in pixels.

format.description: strftime-style date format. The label is redrawn once a day, at local midnight.

on_click.description:
Shell command run on left click, instead of the module's built-in action.
An empty string disables the built-in action without running anything.

on_right_click.description: Shell command run on right click, instead of the module's built-in action.

on_scroll_down.description: Shell command run on scroll down, instead of the module's built-in action.

on_scroll_up.description: Shell command run on scroll up, instead of the module's built-in action.

format.description: strftime-style format. The clock wakes every second only if this shows seconds.

LayoutConfig.description:
Leaving `[layout]` out gives the default layout; once it is written, any
section left out is empty. A module may appear only once across all sections.

center.description: Modules in the center section, in order.

left.description: Modules in the left section, in order.

right.description: Modules in the right section, in order.

icon.description: Icon name: a bundled `zb-*-symbolic` icon or any name from your icon theme. Empty hides the logo.

on_scroll_down.description: Shell command run on scroll down, instead of the module's built-in action.

on_scroll_up.description: Shell command run on scroll up, instead of the module's built-in action.

radius.description: Corner radius of module pills in pixels, overriding `--zb-module-radius`.

surface_opacity.description: Opacity of the bar surface from 0 (clear) to 1 (opaque), overriding `--zb-surface-opacity`.

ThemeName.description: A built-in theme. Only the selected one is ever parsed.
